independent_dem: Copernicus GLO-30 public 2021 release, original COG downloaded and hashed; no blending/vertical conversion
independent_dem_role: independently acquired and product-identifiable; statistical independence from unidentified supplied DEM is unestablished

terrain_grids.domain: paper source/channel/target bounds plus 1500 m, aligned to 120 m

routes.method: 8-neighbour terrain-cost shortest paths; weighted uphill and distance-to-paper-corridor; three predeclared cost variants, no imposed real connector
routes.independence: routes conditional on paper target; not independently observed propagation

optical.role: actual pixel availability/quality and geometric screening; not labels or automated causal change attribution

osm.role: independent volunteer mapping snapshot, not event geometry truth; bridge and port facility separately labelled

null_policy: unknown observation epoch or object position uncertainty remains null
